name: Panel Linear Service
description: Defines LinearService features (manually routed electrical or plumbing runs) for a panel component's 'features' input. By default the populator's LinearServiceDetailSet drills every core beam the service crosses; give it LinearServiceDetailSet(mode='notching') via 'detail_set' to notch them from the interior face instead. Sheathing is not cut. Holes over 40% and notches over 25% of the beam depth are reported in the populator's DebugInfo.

inputParameters.name: polylines
inputParameters.description: Service paths, drawn on or parallel to the panel they belong to. They are placed on the core layer's mid-plane.

inputParameters.name: thickness
inputParameters.description: Diameter of the service: the hole diameter, or the notch width and depth.

inputParameters.name: detail_set
inputParameters.description: (Optional) A detail set (CT: Detail Agent Set) that builds these features, in place of the populator's default for this feature type.

outputParameters.name: features
outputParameters.description: Panel feature definitions. Connect to a panel component's 'features' input; each panel adds the ones that lie on it.
